decisions.reason: The decision to retain the existing placement refers specifically to the ESP32 decoupling capacitors, not the separate AXP2101 or MT3608 converter capacitors.
Retaining the ESP32 decoupling-capacitor placement does not change the standalone USB regulator, source selection, powered rail, or loads.
The ESP32 decoupling placement decision does not affect the AXP2101 underside thermal-pad implementation.
The source decision does not alter the switched 5V rail's control, converter, loads, or operating pattern.
Leaving the ESP32 decoupling capacitors in place does not modify the required widths of VBUS, +5V, or BAT- power traces.
The source decision concerns ESP32 decoupling placement and does not change access to the AXP2101 VBACKUP pin.
The physical placement of ESP32 decoupling capacitors does not change the specified clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The source decision does not alter the requested AXP2101 PWROK test-pad or via access.
Retaining the ESP32 decoupling placement does not change which power rails must be monitored or the monitoring architecture.
The ESP32 decoupling decision has no effect on the panel power-button connector, location, signal, or switching behavior.
The source decision does not change the AXP2101 selection, battery power path, required rails, or charging behavior.
Leaving the ESP32 decoupling capacitors at their existing distance does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or compensation purpose.
